mapper.sql: accommodation_outbound_click_id, accommodation_booking_id, user_id, trip_id, offer_id, provider, deeplink_url, clicked_at, returned_at, outcome
mapper.update: UPDATE accommodation_outbound_clicks SET outcome = #{outcome}, returned_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE accommodation_outbound_click_id = #{accommodationOutboundClickId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (accommodation_booking_id) FROM accommodation_outbound_clicks WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND outcome IS NULL ORDER BY accommodation_booking_id, clicked_at DESC
